manifest.selection: Eight developer/community platforms with explicit upstream fixtures and reviewable public references. Every fixture stays on its source platform. Two deterministic synthetic candidates per platform. Sample fixed before predictions.
manifest.ownership: Published upstream testing fixtures, not accounts owned by MyRecon or the user. Account existence does not establish identity. No personal social-media handles or customer history are included.
manifest.reference_policy: Fixture labels and generated randomness are expectations only. Current exact account evidence or explicit absence supplies the reference; failures stay unknown.
